posts.title: Beyond the Flux: Phenomenology, Buddhism, and the Immortal Soul
posts.description: One of the great partial truths of Buddhism is that the self, as experienced, is unstable. When a man begins to observe himself closely, not merely as a thinker of concepts, but as one who watches the movements of consciousness, he discovers that what he ordinarily identifies with his “I” is in fact a stream.
